findings.description: SWR-TIM-001 and SWR-TIM-002 require detection no later than 100 µs after the configured limit expires. The component arms its compare at the limit plus one 100 µs unit, then permits a further 100 µs entry-plus-decision latency. That permits detection 200 µs after the configured limit.
findings.requested_change: Define the compare and decision timing so the worst-case detection time satisfies the 100 µs bound while preserving the equality rule.

findings.description: SWR-LAT-012 counts a code 8 report when it is made, and SWR-LAT-004 latches on the third counted detection. The component increments the code 8 count even when transmission is interrupted and no report is made; a later completed report can therefore latch after fewer than three reports have been made.
findings.requested_change: Align code 8 counting and latch behavior for interrupted reports with SWR-LAT-004 and SWR-LAT-012.

findings.description: The task queues the code 8 report and services transmission between CRC chunks, but does not require report completion before checking the latch and permitting normal start-up. If checks finish before transmission completes, supervised tasks could be released before the third code 8 report sets the latch.
findings.requested_change: Specify the completion ordering and bounded error path needed to ensure the code 8 latch decision is made before permitting supervised task release.
